title: Secura AI 2.0 Evaluation Manifest Schema
description: Controlled evaluation manifest for real-world or licensed benchmark images.

file_path.description: Path relative to manifest or project root

generator_model.description: Model identifier if AI generated (e.g. Midjourney v6, SDXL, DALL-E 3)

camera_hardware.description: Camera/sensor model if authentic capture (e.g. Sony A7 IV)

transformation_history.description: Known processing (e.g. uncompressed, resized, social media recompressed)

samples.origin_description: Author-captured raw camera image exported directly to JPEG
samples.transformation_history: Direct single-generation JPEG export at Q95

samples.origin_description: Locally generated output using documented open-weights diffusion model
samples.transformation_history: Direct lossless PNG generation from model output pipeline
